descriptions.job-1mth3xo:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role 

The North American Mid-Market Sales team at Cash App and Afterpay is responsible for driving revenue across our commerce payments products, giving merchant partners access to one of the largest and most engaged networks of next-generation consumers. We partner with high-growth and established brands across retail, fashion, beauty, travel, QSR, home, health and wellness, ticketing, and other commerce categories to help them acquire customers, increase conversion, and grow profitably.

We are looking for an experienced Mid-Market Account Executive to build and expand relationships with high-potential merchants across North America. You will own a portfolio of prospective merchants, create new pipeline, lead a consultative sales process, and close new business across Cash App Pay and Afterpay.

You will work with founders, executives, and leaders across commerce, marketing, payments, finance, and technology. Internally, you will coordinate partners across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Risk, Sales Strategy, and Operations.

In this role, you will independently own complex sales workstreams, make informed tradeoffs, and influence deal strategy and execution within your area of responsibility. Success requires balancing high-touch relationship development with a structured and repeatable sales process.

You will:

  • Own a portfolio of mid-market opportunities from initial prospecting and qualification through discovery, negotiation, contracting, launch, and handoff.
  • Develop account plans that identify merchant priorities, key decision-makers, potential blockers, and revenue opportunities.
  • Build pipeline through outbound outreach, market research, internal lead assignments, vertical insights, events, referrals, and partner introductions.
  • Qualify and prioritize opportunities based on merchant fit, revenue potential, product alignment, implementation requirements, and likelihood to close.
  • Lead discovery with business and technical stakeholders to understand merchant priorities, customer needs, payment flows, and implementation requirements.
  • Build merchant-specific business cases and sales narratives that connect Cash App Pay and Afterpay’s capabilities to customer acquisition, conversion, and growth goals.
  • Develop commercial proposals and negotiate pricing, financial terms, contracts, procurement requirements, and implementation dependencies.
  • Coordinate deal teams across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Risk, Sales Strategy, and Operations.
  • Manage deal progress using defined milestones, next steps, stakeholder ownership, and internal approval requirements.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity data, pipeline reporting, and sales forecasts in Salesforce and related systems.
  • Bring merchant feedback, competitive intelligence, and market insights back to Product and go-to-market teams.
  • Contribute to sales processes, enablement materials, and operating rhythms that improve pipeline quality, deal velocity, forecast accuracy, and win rates.
  • Deliver against individual revenue and sales targets.
  • Represent Cash App and Afterpay in merchant meetings, industry events, and networking forums.

You have:

  • 5+ years of experience in full-cycle B2B sales, business development, partnerships, or a related go-to-market role, preferably in commerce, payments, fintech, SaaS, retail technology, or another fast-moving technology environment.
  • A demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding quota and closing mid-market or complex commercial deals.
  • Strong prospecting and pipeline-generation skills, including comfort building new business through outbound outreach, market research, partner referrals, events, and executive networking.
  • Executive presence with the ability to earn trust, ask strong questions, influence senior stakeholders, and tailor communication to founders, functional leaders, and cross-functional buying committees.
  • Strong commercial judgment and negotiation skills, including comfort working through pricing, legal terms, procurement, implementation dependencies, and internal approval processes.
  • Comfort using data to build a business case, prioritize opportunities, inspect pipeline quality, and communicate tradeoffs.
  • Product curiosity and technical fluency, especially around payments, commerce, customer acquisition, marketing, and merchant growth.
  • A self-starter mentality and comfort operating through ambiguity, frequent change, and evolving priorities while still delivering results.
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to lead workstreams without formal authority.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to build concise, compelling narratives for internal and external audiences.
  • A continuous-improvement mindset and willingness to help build better team processes, enablement materials, and operating rhythms.
  • A willingness to travel for merchant meetings, industry events, and internal team moments.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe's Global Partner Marketing team drives growth by developing and scaling go-to-market programs with Stripe's most strategic channel, technology, and alliance partners. Working cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and GTM teams, the team builds the infrastructure, enablement, and co-marketing programs that extend Stripe's reach across the partner ecosystem.

What you’ll do

As the Partner Marketing Operations Manager, you will serve as the operational backbone of Stripe's Global Partner Marketing organization. You'll own the team's OPEX budget, rhythm of business, and cross-functional programs — ensuring the organization runs with precision, data-driven accountability, and operational excellence. This role has broad visibility across the entire partner ecosystem and direct impact on how Stripe scales through its global partner network.

Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end OPEX budget inclusive of marketing dollars, headcount, and non-headcount spend; forecast and land budget within 1% variance to plan
  • Design and manage the Partner Marketing team's rhythm of business (ROB), including structure, cadence, and reporting frameworks
  • Partner with the analytics team and partner marketing leaders to define requirements and integrate data into the ROB, establishing a single source of truth for measuring and reporting on partner marketing impact
  • Lead cross-team operational initiatives including weekly snippets, AI project prioritization, go/partner-marketing site and assets, team meetings, offsites, and town halls
  • Build and maintain an inventory of system and tool requirements that enhance the partner experience or address integration blockers for partners entering Stripe's GTM motion (e.g., Salesforce integration, partner recommender)
  • Lead and program-manage cross-team strategic initiatives as identified and prioritized by the Head of Global Partner Marketing

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 15+ years of experience in a highly matrixed enterprise technology organization
  • 15+ years of business and/or program management experience
  • 10+ years of partner ecosystem experience
  • Demonstrated track record managing large operating budgets with high precision
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Proven ability to lead collaboratively and influence across functions and levels

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in a global strategy and operations or Chief of Staff function, with direct ownership of budget, cross-functional communications, and program operations
  • Proven track record of influencing without authority, leading change management, and building cohesion across a newly formed or restructured team
  • Strong systems thinker with the ability to identify operating model gaps and navigate cross-functional prioritization (e.g., with analytics, campaigns, or product roadmap teams)
  • Composure and independent judgment in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with minimal direction
descriptions.job-1uioazw:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Talent Management & Analytics team within our PeopleX organization is building the next generation of data tools, integrating advanced predictive insights and AI into our workforce systems. We create the data solutions that help the company recruit great talent, build high-performing teams, and put real-time insights into the hands of decision-makers. At the intersection of data science, product development, and organizational psychology, we're changing how Robinhood uses data to support our employees and forecast organizational needs.

As a PeopleX Insights & Analytics Intern, you'll work with our team to design and build high-impact data products that our leaders and managers rely on. You'll contribute to analyses that help us understand what allows talent to thrive, how to accelerate team performance, and how to build better retention strategies. This is a unique opportunity to apply cutting-edge language models and predictive analytics to meaningful work under the mentorship of a data scientist and our talent management team.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Develop and refine predictive models to forecast workforce trends, such as attrition risk and hiring velocity.
  • Build and maintain automated data pipelines to transform raw people data into reliable, real-time insights using SQL and dbt.
  • Support the design of scientifically-backed survey methodologies and "always-on" employee listening strategies to surface actionable organizational health signals.
  • Create high-fidelity visualizations and dashboards that translate complex organizational data into clear, executive-ready insights.
  • Collaborate with the team on AI-driven workflows to automate the analysis and summarization of unstructured feedback and internal documentation.
  • Ensure data integrity by defining metric dictionaries and maintaining a robust semantic layer for core People KPIs.

What you bring

  • Pursuing a graduate degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related quantitative field with an expected graduation date of Winter 2027/Summer 2028. Preference for related work experience in HR (prior internship(s), co-op roles, etc)
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python/R for data manipulation and statistical analysis, with a portfolio or projects showcasing your ability to draw insights from complex datasets.
  • You’re curious and excited about a fast-paced work environment centered on learning and contributing to the business
  • You’re organized and detail‑oriented with a knack for project coordination
  • You have strong written and verbal communication skills and thrive in team collaboration
  • Familiarity with tools like Workday, Slack, and the Google Suite are a plus

What we offer

  • Market competitive compensation structure
  • Quarterly lifestyle wallet for personal wellness, learning and development, and more!
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not
  • Time away including company holidays, paid time off, and sick time!

About Bullish

Bullish is an institutionally focused global digital asset platform that provides market infrastructure and information services. These include: Bullish Exchange – a regulated and institutionally focused digital assets spot and derivatives exchange, integrating a high-performance central limit order book matching engine with automated market making to provide deep and predictable liquidity. Bullish Exchange is regulated in Germany, Hong Kong, and Gibraltar. CoinDesk Indices – a collection of tradable proprietary and single-asset benchmarks and indices that track the performance of digital assets for global institutions in the digital assets and traditional finance industries. CoinDesk Data - a broad suite of digital assets market data and analytics, providing real-time insights into prices, trends, and market dynamics. CoinDesk Insights – a digital asset media and events provider and operator of Coindesk.com, a digital media platform that covers news and insights about digital assets, the underlying markets, policy, and blockchain technology.

Reports to:

CISO Americas

Position Overview 

At Bullish, security is not a checkpoint, it is the foundation of trust that lets people move billions across our markets with confidence. The Bullish Security Architecture team secures Bullish Global, including the Bullish Exchange, Bullish Liquidity Services, CoinDesk Indices, CoinDesk Data, CoinDesk Media, and CoinDesk Events, designing the defenses that keep our mission-critical trading systems and other business lines resilient against the most capable adversaries in the world.

As a senior member on this team, you will sit at the intersection of cutting-edge engineering and high-stakes finance, shaping how secure software is built across web, API, mobile, and FIX platforms, and pushing our security bar beyond industry-leading. This is a senior technical leadership role, a hands-on application and cloud security architect who leads through influence, deep expertise, and mentorship. 

If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges in a fast-moving crypto landscape and building first-of-their-kind systems, this is where you will do the most impactful work of your career.

This position is based in SoHo London and will be required to work full-time onsite.

Responsibilities

  • Build complex threat models for critical systems and establish industry-leading cybersecurity requirements to turn ambiguity into clear, prioritized defenses.

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to design and ship secure software across web, API, mobile, FIX, and trading platforms.

  • Lead complex global security initiatives, build custom AI-powered tooling to maximize efficiency and scale the cybersecurity program.

  • Assess vulnerability risks, deliver actionable recommendations across all technical levels, and track health metrics and KPIs for executive reporting.

  • Drive high-impact projects and adapt to evolving business needs within a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the cybersecurity and engineering teams.

Experience & Qualifications: 

  • 10+ years in cybersecurity, including 5+ years of hands-on coding, alongside deep expertise in threat modeling, pen testing, code reviews, and offensive security methodologies.

  • Strong foundation in network protocols (IP, DNS, HTTP, SSL/TLS), cryptography (PKI, encryption at rest/in motion), Linux environments, and public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Proficient in programming languages like C/C++, Java, JS, Python, Go, or Rust

  • Possess a deep understanding of common vulnerability frameworks (OWASP Top 10, SANS CWE Top 25).

  • Solid grasp of enterprise software development, Agile, CI/CD pipelines, and security tooling (SAST, DAST, OSA, Vulnerability Management, API traceability).

  • Excellent ability to convey complex technical risks to non-technical executives and engineers and build strong cross-functional partnerships.

  • A strong individual contributor with ability to drive projects independently from conception to complete with minimal oversight.  

Nice to Have:

  • A restless drive to secure systems and continuously learn new technologies. 

  • Experience securing trading, financial-market, or other regulated, high-stakes systems. 

  • Relevant certifications, such as security architecture certifications (e.g. SABSA, TOGAF), offensive security (e.g. OSCP, OSCE, SANS, CREST) and cloud security specialty certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP). 

Bullish is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are fast evolving and striving towards being a globally-diverse community. With integrity at our core, our success is driven by a talented team of individuals and the different perspectives they are encouraged to bring to work every day.

Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM Labs is the intelligence platform for public safety and national security. Our AI-powered platform helps agencies trace illicit activity, map threat networks, and build cases-enabling investigators to disrupt the world’s most serious crimes at machine speed.

Our technology has supported efforts to disrupt fentanyl trafficking, trace terrorist financing, dismantle malware infrastructure alongside the FBI, and follow funds tied to one of the largest crypto seizures on record.

This is a dedicated, single-account role on TRM’s US National Security team, owning one of our most strategic Intelligence Community relationships. You’ll build TRM’s presence from the ground up, turning established relationships and deep mission expertise into a multi-year, multi-program partnership. You’ll own the account end to end, work directly with TRM’s founders and product leadership, and help shape mission-critical technology for national security customers.

This role requires US citizenship, an active TS/SCI with Full-Scope Polygraph on Day 1, and experience in this customer’s mission environment.

Why you’ll love this role

  • Own a flagship account & BUILD at the highest level. Not one of twenty reps chasing the same logos. You’re the primary seller for this account, shaping TRM’s footprint program by program.

  • Mission that’s viscerally real - Your work supports the people protecting national security every day.

  • Startup speed and founder access - Direct visibility with TRM’s leadership and product teams, and a real hand in the roadmap.

  • A career-defining ownership role with a path to leadership as the portfolio grows.

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity at a high-growth company.

The impact you will have:

  • Own the entire account relationship and mapping stakeholders from operational analysts through program leadership, understanding mission priorities, and positioning TRM as essential infrastructure for their workflows.

  • Lead all commercial activity: renewals, expansions into new programs, and net-new pipeline built around use cases where TRM meaningfully supports the mission.

  • Develop and maintain a 12-month rolling account plan, mapping pipeline to named programs, budget cycles, and contract vehicles - always maintaining 3x quota coverage.

  • Partner with Solutions Architecture on technical demonstrations and proof-of-concept engagements, translating operational requirements into compelling proposals.

  • Serve as the internal voice of the customer - bringing mission feedback to Product, Intel Products, and Compliance Advisory to shape TRM’s national security capabilities.

  • Navigate a complex procurement landscape - identifying contract vehicles, partnering with Legal and Deal Desk to structure compliant deals, and building pipeline well ahead of budget cycles.

  • Develop a roster of internal champions who advocate for TRM’s expansion across new programs and mission sets.

What we're looking for:

  • Active TS/SCI with Full-Scope Polygraph (FSP Poly) — required on Day 1; no exceptions. This position requires US Citizenship; candidates with dual citizenship are not eligible.

  • 8+ years of enterprise SaaS/software sales into intelligence community or DoD agencies, OR 4+ years with deep demonstrated domain knowledge specific to the customers' mission environment

  • Pre-existing named relationships at the Maryland account or within its immediate peer network — you are known and trusted in this community

  • Demonstrated track record of closing six and seven-figure deals in classified government procurement environments, including experience with IDIQs, OTAs, GWACs, and government budget cycles

  • Farmer mentality: you find fulfillment in deepening long-term customer relationships, obsessing over mission alignment, and building the trust that leads to multi-year, multi-program partnerships

  • Strong consultative skills — you ask great discovery questions, listen actively, and build compelling narratives that tie TRM's capabilities to the customer's specific mission outcomes

  • Autonomous and owner-minded: you write your own proposals, build your own briefings, and do not rely on leadership to close deals

  • Excellent communication in both classified and unclassified settings: you can present complex blockchain intelligence concepts clearly to non-technical mission owners and to senior executives alike

About the Team:

  • TRM's National Security team operates with Focus, Accountability, Consistency, and Execution (F.A.C.E) — the same values we sell our customers on, we live internally

  • The team is highly collaborative: NatSec ADs share competitive intelligence, procurement learnings, and customer insights freely to strengthen everyone's accounts

  • Communication is Slack-first; @mentions are used liberally and responsiveness is expected during core EST business hours

  • Weekly 1:1s, bi-weekly team syncs, and monthly Pod meetings with the broader support organization (SA, Legal, Compliance Advisory, Intel Products)

  • The team predominantly operates in EST, with some PST overlap; most members are customer-facing from ~8 AM to 5 PM, with flexibility needed around customer mission rhythms and classified site requirements

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Weekly 1:1 with hiring manager

  • Bi-weekly NatSec team sync

  • Weekly pipeline and deal review

  • Monthly forecast calls with NatSec leadership

  • Quarterly business reviews with strategic accounts

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Day-1 Relationship Leverage: You will use pre-existing personal relationships to book meetings with key program decision-makers within your first two weeks — not month two — giving TRM an immediate commercial advantage that no competitor without your network can match

  • Mission-Driven Pipeline Seeding: Within 60 days, you will identify at least one new TRM use case specific to the customers mission set and convert it into a qualified pipeline opportunity — turning your domain knowledge into direct ARR before you've completed full product ramp

  • Account Plan Precision: Within 30 days, you will deliver an account plan that maps every known program, stakeholder, and contract vehicle to a 12-month pipeline forecast — giving TRM leadership and Deal Desk the visibility needed to resource the account correctly from the start

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Required Qualifications and Skills

descriptions.job-1nntlpo:
Who we are:

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

Our culture:

  • We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.

  • We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

  • We're a remote-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to - work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport-optional, work-from-anywhere-on-Earth kind of remote - think flexible within your country, not borderless.

Location:

  • Remote -United States or Canada

About the role

Sardine sits on one of the richest behavioral datasets in fraud and risk: device intelligence, behavior biometrics, session telemetry, payment events, and consortium signals that we leverage to fight fraud across hundreds of fintechs and banks. We are looking for an applied research scientist that brings their expertise in deep learning and foundation models to take this to the next level.


We are looking for an experienced ML applied scientist that can combine foundation model expertise with rich non-text sequential data to come up with practical, state-of-the-art fraud detection solutions. You will have an opportunity to scope and drive the next generation of fraud foundation models at Sardine, and drive industry-wide adoption.


What you'll be doing

  • Identify and scope opportunities, design rigorous experiments, and execute on the roadmap for foundation model research and development.

  • Own the evaluation bar for foundation model performance: offline benchmarks, time- and entity-aware holdouts, calibration, drift and degradation monitoring, and honest head-to-head comparisons against strong classical baselines.

  • Take models the full distance from data prep and tokenization through pretraining, fine-tuning, distillation, quantization, and deployment behind a real-time inference path with tight latency budgets.

  • Partner with Engineering on training infrastructure, GPU efficiency, feature and embedding stores, and serving at production scale

  • Work directly with client-facing teams and customers to turn model capabilities and limits into decisions their risk teams can act on.

  • Partner with Legal, Compliance, and customer model risk teams to build the explainability, documentation, and governance our bank and fintech customers need to satisfy their own regulators.

What you'll need

  • 4+ years in applied machine learning, quantitative modeling, or ML engineering including at least one foundation model you pre trained or substantially adapted and put in front of real traffic

  • Hands-on self-supervised pre training experience, plus practical fine-tuning and adaptation

  • Production experience with model serving, versioning, monitoring, and rollback

  • Ability to self-manage and drive ambiguous applied research projects with clear communication with partner teams across data science, engineering, product, marketing and external partners

  • Strong Python, strong SQL, and comfort preparing very large datasets

Nice to haves

  • Background in fraud, AML, payments, credit, or adversarial machine learning

  • Experience building and evaluating LLM-based agents in production

  • Publications, released models, or open source contributions in representation learning or sequence modeling

  • Experience with model risk management and documentation in a regulated financial environment

 
 
 
 

Benefits we offer:

  • Generous compensation in cash and equity

  • Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested

  • Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture

  • Flexible paid time off and Year-end break

  • Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific

  • 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific

  • MacBook Pro delivered to your door

  • One-time stipend to set up a home office — desk, chair, screen, etc.

  • Monthly meal stipend

  • Monthly social meet-up stipend

  • Annual health and wellness stipend

  • Annual Learning stipend

Join a fast-growing company with world-class professionals from around the world. If you are seeking a meaningful career, you found the right place, and we would love to hear from you.

To learn more about how we process your personal information and your rights in regards to your personal information as an applicant and Sardine employee, please visit our Applicant and Worker Privacy Notice.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. About the team

Stripe Terminal helps businesses extend their online presence into the physical world. Our mission is to make it as easy for businesses to accept in-person payments as Stripe has made it to accept payments online.

Terminal provides an integrated in-person payments platform spanning software, payment processing, device fleet management, and hardware. Our hardware portfolio includes Stripe-designed readers and accessories as well as devices from third-party hardware partners. Together, these products enable businesses to build reliable, differentiated in-person payment experiences across a broad range of use cases, countries, and operating environments.

We’re looking for an experienced Product Manager to build the strategy, development, and expansion of Terminal’s hardware portfolio. This role will work across both first-party and third-party hardware, helping define the multi-year roadmap for the devices, accessories, and partner ecosystem that power Terminal.

You will partner closely with hardware engineering, firmware and software engineering, design, operations, logistics, partnerships, sales, finance, legal, and regional teams. This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who can connect customer needs, technical constraints, business strategy, and execution across user experience, device capabilities, cost, quality, reliability, supply, and time to market.

Responsibilities

  • Set and execute a multi-year strategy and roadmap for Terminal hardware across Stripe-built devices, third-party devices, accessories, and emerging form factors.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of product management experience or equivalent experience leading complex technology products.
  • Demonstrated success shipping physical hardware, connected devices, embedded products, payments devices, consumer electronics, or similarly complex products from concept through launch.
  • Experience defining and driving product strategy, roadmaps, requirements, prioritization, and launch plans for technical products.
  • Experience partnering closely with hardware, firmware, and software engineering teams and the ability to participate credibly in technical product and architecture discussions.
  • Strong judgment in navigating trade-offs across customer experience, technical feasibility, reliability, quality, cost, supply, and launch timing.
  • Experience with hardware product-development and manufacturing processes, including prototype development, validation, production readiness, and sustaining lifecycle management.
  • Experience working with external vendors, manufacturers, OEMs, ODMs, or other strategic technology partners.
  • A customer-focused and analytical approach to product development, with experience leading cross-functional programs, creating alignment, and using evidence to set priorities and measure outcomes.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in payments, commerce platforms, point-of-sale systems, or in-person payments.
  • Experience managing a portfolio that includes both first-party products and third-party partner products.
  • Experience with sourcing, supply-chain risk, device pricing, unit economics, and global distribution.

descriptions.job-0y1zip8:
About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

 

About the Role

The exchange is the core of what Polymarket does. Every trade, every order, every market resolution runs through the systems this team owns. As a Staff Backend Engineer on the Services team, you'll be working directly on that infrastructure, building and scaling the backend that processes real money, in real time, at meaningful volume. The work is technical, high-stakes, and unambiguous in its consequences.

This is an individual contributor role with high autonomy and high ownership. You'll work alongside a small group of senior engineers who care deeply about correctness and performance. There's no heavy process here, no committees, no long approval chains. You'll be expected to identify problems, propose solutions, and ship them. The mandate is simple: keep the exchange fast, correct, and available as Polymarket continues to scale.

If you've spent your career building systems where performance actually matters, where a bug in production has real consequences, this is the kind of problem you've been waiting to work on.

 

What You'll Do

  • Design and implement low-latency backend services that power Polymarket's core exchange, primarily in Go, with Python or Java where appropriate.

  • Profile and tune systems across the full stack, identifying bottlenecks in latency, throughput, and memory usage before they become production problems.

  • Build and maintain event-driven data pipelines and APIs using streaming platforms like Kafka or Pulsar, ensuring data moves reliably and quickly across the exchange.

  • Own production reliability for the systems you build, including diagnosing live incidents, writing postmortems, and shipping fixes that prevent recurrence.

  • Work directly with engineers across product, infrastructure, and data to integrate exchange services tightly with the broader platform.

  • Contribute to architectural decisions on distributed systems design, with a focus on failure modes, graceful degradation, and recovery under partial outages.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of professional backend development experience, with strong proficiency in Go, Python, or Java. Go experience is a significant advantage.

  • Deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, concurrency, and memory management, with a track record of applying that knowledge to real production systems.

  • Experience building and debugging high-throughput, low-latency systems on Linux end-to-end, from design through to production operation.

  • Strong instincts for correctness, especially in systems where failures have financial consequences. You write defensively, think about edge cases early, and treat bugs in prod as a serious matter.

  • Comfortable working independently in a high-autonomy environment. You identify what needs to be done and do it without waiting to be unblocked.

  • (Plus) Experience in trading systems, high-frequency trading, gaming, telecom, or any domain where latency is a hard constraint, not a stretch goal.

  • (Plus) Production experience with Kafka, Pulsar, or similar streaming platforms at meaningful scale.

  • (Plus) Familiarity with gRPC, Protobuf, or ZeroMQ.

  • (Plus) Experience deploying and operating services in cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, using containers and modern deployment tooling.

 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

  • 401k match

  • Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

Pay Transparency

Base salary range: $250,000 to $500,000, plus equity and benefits.

This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.

Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

Millions of customers trust Bitpanda to protect their money, identities and digital assets. As a Senior SOC Analyst, you'll play a critical role in staying ahead of evolving threats by building the capabilities that detect attacks, respond to incidents and continuously strengthen our security posture. 

You'll combine deep technical expertise with engineering excellence to evolve our security operations, drive automation at scale and partner across the business to embed security into everything we build. Your work will directly shape how Bitpanda protects its customers today; and how it stays resilient tomorrow.

What you'll do

  • Detection engineering. Own the strategy and quality of our detection library in Elastic Security (ES|QL/KQL), designing high-fidelity detections mapped to real-world attacker techniques while continuously improving coverage, reducing noise and raising the maturity of our SOC.

*For this role we offer relocation benefits within the European Union to get you up and running in Vienna

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

  • Serve as a senior post-sales architecture advisor to a portfolio of global enterprise users with complex, multi-product Stripe integrations, helping them evolve from an initial solution vision to durable target-state integration and architecture decisions, supported by transformation roadmaps.
  • Partner with Integration Engineers, Implementation Consultants, Engagement Managers, Account Executives, and Strategy & Transformation Consultants to shape post-sales architecture engagements and provide senior guidance, while detailed solution design and implementation delivery remain with the appropriate Stripe teams.
  • Advise user technical teams on architecture-level decisions across the broader enterprise commerce, finance, and data landscape—including system-of-record boundaries, API and event design, data ownership, reconciliation, operational resilience, security and risk considerations, and organizational readiness.
  • Act as an escalation and thought partner for complex enterprise architecture questions during implementation, expansion, and major evolution of Stripe integrations, translating technical trade-offs across Stripe products into clear decisions, dependencies, and business outcomes for customer and Stripe stakeholders.

Shape enterprise commerce transformation strategy

  • Lead executive discovery, strategy and architecture workshops for Stripe’s most strategic enterprise prospects and users.
  • Assess a customer’s current commerce and technology landscape, identifying how payments and financial infrastructure interact with commerce, order management, ERP and finance, CRM, loyalty, identity, data, fulfillment, and risk systems and develop a prescriptive future-state point of view for how Stripe can serve as a financial backbone within that architecture.
  • Translate business objectives—such as international expansion, omnichannel commerce, marketplace growth, subscription transformation, cost optimization, improved authorization performance, or faster product development—into clear architecture and operating-model implications.
  • Define the enterprise-level principles, system boundaries, ownership models, integration patterns, data flows, and migration considerations needed to support the target state.
  • Create multi-phased, dependency-aware transformation roadmaps that connect Stripe capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

Increase confidence in strategic enterprise pursuits

  • Partner with account teams, enterprise service managers, sales leaders, and senior solutions architects to identify pursuits where enterprise commerce architecture expertise will materially improve customer confidence or decision quality.
  • Engage credibly with executive technical stakeholders as a strategic advisor and peer, not as a product vendor.
  • Help customers understand the practical trade-offs between their current architecture and a future state that uses Stripe more deeply.
  • Create clear executive narratives, architecture artifacts, transformation roadmaps, and decision materials that make Stripe’s role in the customer’s future state concrete.
  • Support account strategy, opportunity shaping, and value articulation for complex, multi-product enterprise pursuits.
  • Help define the path from initial architecture vision to implementation scope, while ensuring detailed solution design and delivery ownership remain with the appropriate Stripe teams.

Inform Stripe’s enterprise strategy and product direction

  • Bring recurring customer architecture patterns, friction points, and unmet needs back to Product, Engineering, and GTM leadership.
  • Identify emerging enterprise commerce trends—including AI-enabled commerce and financial operations, omnichannel experiences, embedded finance, platform business models, and global expansion—and translate them into relevant Stripe points of view.
  • Contribute to Stripe’s differentiated perspective on enterprise commerce transformation through internal thought leadership and selective customer-facing content.

Minimum qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, technology strategy, digital transformation, management consulting, or senior technical advisory roles.
  • Significant experience advising large enterprises on complex technology transformation, ideally spanning commerce, payments, financial systems, or customer-facing platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage credibly with C-suite and VP-level business and technical leaders.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise commerce architecture, including relevant systems such as commerce platforms, order management, ERP and finance, CRM, loyalty, identity, fulfillment, and cloud data platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of API-first integration, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, cloud platforms, data flows, and enterprise operational models.
  • Working knowledge of payments and financial infrastructure, including acceptance, acquiring, settlement, reconciliation, fraud and risk, compliance, and multi-party payment models.
  • Ability to connect architecture decisions to business outcomes such as revenue growth, conversion, authorization performance, operational efficiency, resilience, cost, and speed to market.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including the ability to make complex architecture decisions understandable to executive audiences.
  • Demonstrated experience leading ambiguous, cross-functional strategic engagements from initial discovery through a practical recommendation and roadmap

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with Stripe or comparable payments and financial-infrastructure platforms.
  • Experience in enterprise retail, marketplaces, platforms, SaaS, travel, media, mobility, or other complex commerce environments.
  • Experience across omnichannel commerce, global payment methods, subscriptions, B2B payments, marketplaces, embedded finance, or platform monetization models.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks and methods, such as capability modeling, value-stream analysis, domain-driven design, and transformation roadmapping.
  • Experience advising on data architecture, reconciliation, risk and fraud operations, AI-enabled financial operations, or commerce personalization.
  • A track record of coaching senior technical practitioners and influencing cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.
  • External credibility through senior customer advisory work, industry speaking, publications, or contributions to enterprise technology or payments communities.
descriptions.job-12bbsoc:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.  

Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.

Your role

Stripe is large enough that individual products and projects can be rapidly deployed to a meaningful fraction of the world’s businesses, but small enough that individual agency still has outsized impact. Small teams can impact how millions of businesses grow. Right now the global economy is replatforming around AI, creating new opportunities for growth. We’re at the center of this, and we think the best work is still in front of us.

To meet this moment, we’re looking for people who move with urgency, like hard problems, and want their work to matter at a time of great change. If that’s you, there’s no better place to build your career.

Who you are

  • Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.
  • Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. 
  • Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities.  At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

Minimum requirements

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science or a directly related field, obtained by summer 2027, or equivalent work experience; New grad candidates should have no more than 18 months of professional experience (excluding internship experience).
  • Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Java, Ruby, JavaScript, Scala, and Go. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.
  • Experience from either previous internships or working collaboratively on multi-person coding projects (in a university or professional setting).
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts.
  • Clear written communication skills, with the ability to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes.
  • Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.

Preferred qualifications

  • One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge. 
  • Experience in code review practices, and an understanding of how to safely update production systems.
  • Familiarity with navigating and managing work in large code bases.
  • Experience leading small projects independently, and contributing to larger projects alongside peers.
  • Ability to operate with high agency in navigating complex technical obstacles independently, knowing precisely when to unblock oneself and when to ask for help.
descriptions.job-1mt5t4c:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. What you’ll be responsible for

You will build world-class Web3 consumer applications, web SDKs, and developer tools that make it easier for developers to integrate with Circle’s existing and future product offerings. You will also create internal tools that enable our Customer Success teams to deliver exceptional support. As a member of a dedicated engineering team, you will contribute to Circle’s broader frontend ecosystem by participating in code reviews, promoting consistent engineering practices, and maintaining a high standard for quality. What you’ll work on

  • Build and maintain responsive Web3 applications using modern frontend technologies.

  • Design reusable, accessible, and scalable frontend components for shared use across products.

  • Partner with Product and Design to translate user needs into intuitive, high-quality features.

  • Participate in code and design reviews to improve quality, consistency, and maintainability.

What you’ll bring to Circle

Core requirements
